component.name: VideoComponent
component.script:
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("videoPlayer") m.statusPanel = m.top.findNode("statusPanel") m.statusLabel = m.top.findNode("statusLabel") m.loadWatchdog = m.top.findNode("loadWatchdog") m.skipTimer = m.top.findNode("skipTimer") m.mediaUrlTask = m.top.findNode("mediaUrlTask") m.exitDialog = createObject("roSGNode", "Dialog") m.exitDialog.title = "Return to TV Guide?" m.exitDialog.message = "The rest of this channel's playlist will not be played." m.exitDialog.buttons = [ "Continue Watching", "Return to Guide" ] m.exitDialogActive = false m.active = false
m.top.observeField("playlist", "onPlaylistChanged") m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") m.mediaUrlTask.observeField("mediaUrl", "onMediaUrlResolved") m.mediaUrlTask.observeField("errorMessage", "onMediaUrlError") m.loadWatchdog.observeField("fire", "onLoadTimeout") m.skipTimer.observeField("fire", "playNext") m.exitDialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onExitDialogButton") m.exitDialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onExitDialogClosed") end sub
sub onPlaylistChanged() if m.top.playlist = invalid then return count = m.top.playlist.getChildCount() if count = 0 endPlayback("error") return end if
m.currentIndex = m.top.startIndex if m.currentIndex < 0 then m.currentIndex = 0 if m.currentIndex >= count then m.currentIndex = count - 1 m.active = true playCurrent() end sub
sub playCurrent() if not m.active then return item = m.top.playlist.getChild(m.currentIndex) if item = invalid endPlayback("finished") return end if
if item.resolveUrl <> "" m.resolvePending = true showStatus("Selecting program " + (m.currentIndex + 1).toStr() + " of " + m.top.playlist.getChildCount().toStr() + "...") m.mediaUrlTask.control = "stop" m.mediaUrlTask.uri = item.resolveUrl m.mediaUrlTask.control = "run" return end if startVideo(item.url, item.title, item.streamFormat) end sub
sub onMediaUrlResolved(event as object) mediaUrl = event.getData() if not m.active or not m.resolvePending or mediaUrl = "" then return m.resolvePending = false title = m.top.channelTitle + " - Program " + (m.currentIndex + 1).toStr() startVideo(mediaUrl, title, mediaFormat(mediaUrl)) end sub
sub onMediaUrlError(event as object) message = event.getData() if not m.active or not m.resolvePending or message = "" then return m.resolvePending = false skipFailedItem(message) end sub
sub startVideo(url as string, title as string, streamFormat as string) m.itemStarted = false m.failurePending = false content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = url content.title = title content.streamFormat = streamFormat content.httpCertificatesFile = "common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt"
showStatus("Loading " + content.title + " (" + (m.currentIndex + 1).toStr() + " of " + m.top.playlist.getChildCount().toStr() + ")") m.video.content = content m.video.control = "play" m.loadWatchdog.control = "start" m.video.setFocus(true) end sub
function mediaFormat(url as string) as string cleanUrl = url queryAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "?") if queryAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(queryAt - 1) extension = "" for index = len(cleanUrl) to 1 step -1 character = cleanUrl.mid(index - 1, 1) if character = "." extension = cleanUrl.mid(index).lcase() exit for end if if character = "/" then exit for end for if extension = "m3u8" then return "hls" if extension = "mpd" then return "dash" if extension = "ism" or extension = "isml" then return "ism" if extension = "" then return "mp4" return extension end function
sub onVideoState(event as object) if not m.active then return state = event.getData() if state = "playing" m.itemStarted = true m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" hideStatus() else if state = "finished" if not m.itemStarted then return m.itemStarted = false m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" playNext() else if state = "error" m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" skipFailedItem(playbackErrorMessage()) end if end sub
sub onLoadTimeout() if not m.active then return if m.video.state = "playing" then return m.video.control = "stop" skipFailedItem("This playlist item timed out.") end sub
sub skipFailedItem(message as string) if not m.active or m.failurePending then return m.failurePending = true showStatus(message + " Skipping to the next item...") m.skipTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub playNext() if not m.active then return m.skipTimer.control = "stop" m.failurePending = false m.currentIndex++ if m.currentIndex >= m.top.playlist.getChildCount() endPlayback("finished") else playCurrent() end if end sub
function playbackErrorMessage() as string if m.video.errorMsg <> invalid and m.video.errorMsg <> "" then return m.video.errorMsg + "." return "This playlist item could not be played." end function
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" and m.active if not m.exitDialogActive m.exitDialogActive = true m.top.getScene().dialog = m.exitDialog end if return true end if return false end function
sub onExitDialogButton(event as object) choice = event.getData() m.exitDialog.close = true if choice = 1 then endPlayback("user") end sub
sub onExitDialogClosed() m.exitDialogActive = false if m.active then m.video.setFocus(true) end sub
sub showStatus(message as string) m.statusLabel.text = message m.statusPanel.visible = true m.statusLabel.visible = true end sub
sub hideStatus() m.statusPanel.visible = false m.statusLabel.visible = false end sub
sub endPlayback(reason as string) m.active = false m.resolvePending = false m.itemStarted = false m.failurePending = false m.mediaUrlTask.control = "stop" m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" m.skipTimer.control = "stop" m.video.control = "stop" hideStatus() if m.exitDialogActive m.exitDialogActive = false m.exitDialog.close = true end if m.top.exitReason = reason m.top.playbackEnded = true end sub
